name: std::basic_streambuf<CharT,Traits>::gbump
intro: Skips count characters in the get area. This is done by adding count to the get pointer. No checks are done for underflow.

sections.title: Parameters
sections.text:
count

 -

 number of characters to skip

sections.title: Notes
sections.text: Because this function takes an int, it cannot manipulate buffers larger than std::numeric_limits<int>::max() characters (LWG issue 255).
